text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. Today's 
competition is fierce, featuring 
contenders like Fine Motion, who shone on 
the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S draws attention from the 
other runners. Yet, she heads into the 
race determined to win, regardless of who 
her opponents are.
